newyork.name: New York
newyork.detail: AAG 2027 exhibition and the Webby Awards

usa.name: United States
usa.detail: US-based organizers with no fixed venue (entries online or by post)

ottawa.name: Canada
ottawa.detail: Canadian Cartographic Association (national, no fixed venue)

edinburgh.name: Edinburgh
edinburgh.detail: BCS conference 2026 and DataFest; BCS 2027 venue not announced

aarhus.name: Aarhus
aarhus.detail: Sigma Awards began at Aarhus University; now hosted online by GIJN

paris.name: Paris
paris.detail: State of the Map 2026; 2027 venue not announced

frankfurt.name: Frankfurt am Main
frankfurt.detail: Seat of the Kartographie-Stiftung Ravenstein; 2026 ceremony on 12 Nov

zurich.name: Zurich
zurich.detail: D ONE and the Data Innovation Alliance

vienna.name: Vienna
vienna.detail: European Newspaper Congress, where the award is presented

yerevan.name: Yerevan
yerevan.detail: Open Data Day Armenia, where winners are announced

awards.name: GIS Day Kazakhstan 2026 · Map & Cake Competition
awards.label: Event 19–20 Nov 2026
awards.prize: Prizes for the best entries, shown at GIS Day Kazakhstan 2026. Amounts not published.
awards.elig: Anyone attending GIS Day Kazakhstan. Bring a map, or bake a map-themed cake.
awards.need: Register through the Map & Cake form, then bring the map (print or screen) or the cake to the event.
awards.note: 5th edition, theme “Innovations in Geospatial Technologies”. Day 1 talks, day 2 workshops. Contact: gistem.almaty@gmail.com.

awards.name: #30DayMapChallenge
awards.label: 1–30 Nov, every year
awards.prize: No prize. One map a day on a daily theme; good for visibility and a portfolio.
awards.elig: Anyone, any tool.
awards.need: Post a map for each daily theme with #30DayMapChallenge on any social platform.
awards.note: Running now. Themes are on 30daymapchallenge.com.

awards.name: ArcGIS StoryMaps Competition 2026
awards.label: 11 Dec 2026, 17:00 PT
awards.prize: Certificate, feature and interview on the StoryMaps site, award presented at Esri UC 2027. No cash prize listed.
awards.elig: Age 18+, worldwide, one entry in one of four categories. Separate student finalist slots.
awards.need: A published ArcGIS StoryMaps story and the online entry form.
awards.note: Up to 5 finalists and 3 student finalists per category, announced 9 Feb 2027, then a public vote. One category is “Seeing What Others Missed”.

awards.name: 31st Webby Awards
awards.org: International Academy of Digital Arts and Sciences
awards.label: 18 Dec 2026 (final)
awards.prize: Webby and People's Voice awards, including Best Data Visualization and an AI Data Visualization & Reporting category.
awards.fee: Paid per entry; rises after each deadline
awards.elig: Websites, apps, video and interactive work published online.
awards.need: Live URL, category choice and entry fee.
awards.note: Early deadline was 30 Oct 2026; extended deadline 5 Feb 2027. Winners in spring 2027.

awards.name: European Newspaper Award
awards.label: Expected late Nov 2026
awards.prize: Awards of Excellence, including infographics categories with one focused on maps.
awards.elig: Newspapers and their websites in Europe; work published 1 Nov 2025 – 15 Nov 2026.
awards.need: PDFs or links of the published pages, submitted by the newspaper.
awards.note: Submission opened 1 Oct; this round's deadlines are still listed as to be announced. Past rounds closed around the end of November.

awards.name: 54th CaGIS Map Design Competition
awards.label: 31 Jan 2027
awards.prize: Students: $500 + Avenza MAPublisher (Arthur Robinson Award for print, David Woodward Award for digital). Professional categories: awards.
awards.fee: Free for students; check the form for professional entries
awards.elig: Anyone, for maps completed or published in 2026.
awards.need: Entry form by email; a printed copy by post unless the map is digital or interactive.
awards.note: Professional categories: Reference, Thematic, Interactive/Digital, Book/Atlas, Recreation/Travel, Other.

awards.name: Atlas of Design, Volume 8
awards.label: 18 Jan 2027, 23:59 PST
awards.prize: Publication in a printed, juried book of map design, published every two years (Vol. 7 had 33 maps).
awards.elig: Anyone; no limits on subject, geography or language.
awards.need: Map image and description through the online submission form, plus a statement on whether generative AI was used.
awards.note: AI-use disclosure is new for Vol. 8 (AoD blog, 23 Oct 2026).

awards.name: U.S. Children's Map Competition 2027
awards.label: 22 Jan 2027 (arrival)
awards.prize: Exhibition at AAG 2027 in New York (8–12 Feb). Up to six entries go on to the ICA Barbara Petchenik competition.
awards.elig: US children. Theme: “Maps in Everyday Life”.
awards.need: An original drawing and entry form, mailed to the Esri Library in Redlands.
awards.note: US qualifying round for the international Petchenik competition at ICC 2027.

awards.name: The Data Lab Data Visualisation Competition
awards.label: 15 Jan 2027
awards.prize: Finalists present online (4–5 Feb 2027); shortlisted entrants invited to DataFest, Edinburgh (12–13 May 2027).
awards.elig: Members of The Data Lab Community; check the page for residency rules.
awards.need: A visualization built on the competition's open data, submitted online.
awards.note: Popular with students and early-career analysts.

awards.name: Sigma Awards
awards.label: Expected mid-Jan 2027
awards.prize: International recognition for data journalism; map-led projects regularly win.
awards.elig: Data journalism projects published in 2026.
awards.need: Project link and a written description of the data work.
awards.note: 2026 edition closed 11 Jan 2026, extended to 18 Jan. Call for 2027 not yet published.

awards.name: PacificVis 2027 Visual Data Storytelling Contest
awards.label: 1 Feb 2027
awards.prize: Contest awards and presentation at PacificVis, Busan, 19–22 Apr 2027.
awards.elig: Researchers, students and practitioners.
awards.need: A data story plus a short write-up in the conference format.
awards.note: Notifications 15 Feb 2027.

awards.name: SND Best of News Design (SND48)
awards.label: Expected mid-Feb 2027
awards.prize: Medals and World's Best designations, including information graphics and maps.
awards.fee: Paid per entry; prices rise after the standard deadline
awards.elig: News organisations, freelancers and students.
awards.need: PDFs or links of published work, entered through Award Force.
awards.note: SND47: standard deadline 14 Feb 2026, extended 6 Mar 2026.

awards.name: ICA Honours and Awards
awards.label: 17 Feb 2027 (to ICA)
awards.prize: Carl Mannerfelt Gold Medal, Honorary Fellowship and other ICA honours, presented at ICC 2027.
awards.elig: Nominations come only from ICA national members. National committees set earlier dates (US: 1 Feb 2027).
awards.need: A nomination dossier from your national ICA committee.
awards.note: Recognises career contributions, not a single map.

awards.name: Open Data Armenia Contest
awards.label: Expected Jan–Mar 2027
awards.prize: $3,000 total prize fund. Categories: Culture Apps of Armenia, Data Visualization, and a Dateno.io special prize for AI-assisted work.
awards.elig: Individuals or teams of up to 5, from any country, working with open data about Armenia.
awards.need: An openly licensed project (CC, MIT or Apache 2) that stays online for at least a year.
awards.note: 2026: 14 Jan – 6 Mar 2026, winners announced 13 Mar at Open Data Day in Yerevan.

awards.name: Esri Young Scholars Award 2027
awards.label: Expected March 2027
awards.prize: Varies by country. National winners are showcased at the Esri User Conference.
awards.elig: Students where the local Esri office runs the award; the project must use Esri software.
awards.need: A project poster or story map and the national application form.
awards.note: 2027 round opens Nov 2026. 2026 deadlines: Germany/Switzerland 8 Mar, UK 22 Mar, South Africa 28 Mar.

awards.name: AGI Awards for Excellence
awards.label: Expected mid-Mar 2027
awards.prize: Award presented at GEO Business, London (June). One winner per category.
awards.elig: UK geospatial professionals and organisations.
awards.need: Written nomination against the category criteria.
awards.note: 2026 categories: Geospatial Professional, Early Career, Environment & Sustainability, Geospatial Technology, Foresight, Chris Holcroft Award.

awards.name: Norman Nicholson Scholarship
awards.label: 29 Mar 2027 (annual date)
awards.prize: Scholarship plus student CCA membership.
awards.elig: Students at Canadian institutions.
awards.need: A one-page statement on plans for continuing education in cartography.
awards.note: CCA lists 29 March as the yearly application date.

awards.name: Geospatial World Excellence & Leadership Awards
awards.label: Before GWF, 20–22 Apr 2027
awards.prize: Awards presented at Geospatial World Forum, RAI Amsterdam.
awards.elig: Companies, agencies and leaders.
awards.need: Nomination form describing the product, project or policy.
awards.note: Rising Stars 2027 closed 20 Oct 2026. 2027 nomination date not yet published.

awards.name: GISCI Map Contest
awards.label: Expected mid-Apr 2027
awards.prize: $125 cash; GISPs get their next renewal fee waived ($285 value). Winning maps shown at Esri UC if made with Esri software.
awards.elig: Open to map-makers; one winner in each of four categories.
awards.need: Map file and the online submission form.
awards.note: 2026 deadline was 15 April 2026.

awards.name: ICA International Map Exhibition & Map Awards
awards.label: Spring 2027, set by each country
awards.prize: International jury awards in six categories plus a public vote, at ICC 2027 Warsaw.
awards.elig: Maps from ICA member countries, submitted by the national ICA member.
awards.need: Your map sent to your country's national ICA coordinator. New or revised since ICC 2025.
awards.note: Conference theme: Big Data Cartography.

awards.name: Barbara Petchenik Children's Map Competition
awards.label: National rounds, early–mid 2027
awards.prize: Awards in four age groups up to 15, a creativity award and a public award.
awards.elig: Children up to 15, selected through national competitions.
awards.need: A hand-drawn map entered through the national round.
awards.note: Biennial since 1993.

awards.name: CCA Web Map Award
awards.label: 14 May 2027
awards.prize: Award and recognition at the CCA conference; amount on the CCA page.
awards.elig: Students at Canadian post-secondary institutions.
awards.need: A live interactive web map and the application form.
awards.note: Sits alongside CCA's student print map award.

awards.name: Online Journalism Awards
awards.label: Expected mid–late May 2027
awards.prize: OJA awards, some with cash; visual and data storytelling categories.
awards.elig: News organisations and journalists publishing online.
awards.need: Links to published work and an entry statement.
awards.note: 2026 deadlines: early 12 May, late 21 May.

awards.name: Esri UC Map Gallery 2027
awards.label: Expected late May 2027
awards.prize: Top three per category recognised at the UC closing session; Mapper's Choice and the ICA-IMIA Excellence in Cartography award.
awards.elig: Esri UC attendees; the map must use Esri software.
awards.need: Map file (print or digital) through the Call for Maps form, and a UC registration.
awards.note: Past deadlines: 29 May 2026, 6 Jun 2024.

awards.name: BCS Peter Jolly Award
awards.label: Expected June 2027
awards.prize: Best map or data visualisation, chosen by a vote of BCS members. Supported by Ordnance Survey.
awards.elig: BCS members only; any single map or geographic data visualisation, print or digital.
awards.need: The Peter Jolly entry form and the map file.
awards.note: BCS publishes 2027 award details in February 2027. The 2025 awards closed 22 June 2025.

awards.name: BCS Stanfords Award for Printed Mapping
awards.label: Expected June 2027
awards.prize: Trophy and certificate.
awards.elig: Any printed mapping: poster, folded sheet map, atlas or book page.
awards.need: Electronic entry plus a hard copy that reaches the BCS Awards Officer by the closing date.
awards.note: 2026 winner: “The Boroughs of London” by Mike Hall and Matt Brown.

awards.name: BCS Collins Bartholomew Award
awards.label: Expected June 2027
awards.prize: Trophy and certificate for thematic mapping and infographics.
awards.elig: Thematic maps and infographics that communicate their theme well.
awards.need: The BCS awards form and the map or infographic.
awards.note: Judged on originality and clarity of the theme.

awards.name: BCS Ordnance Survey Student Award
awards.org: British Cartographic Society with Ordnance Survey
awards.label: Expected June 2027
awards.prize: £100, a year of OS Maps, a trophy and a certificate.
awards.elig: Full- or part-time students.
awards.need: The BCS awards form and a map or visualisation that uses geographic data in a new way.
awards.note: Rewards innovative use and visualisation of geographic data.

awards.name: BCS Garsdale Design Award (3D Cartography)
awards.org: British Cartographic Society with Garsdale Design
awards.label: Expected June 2027
awards.prize: Annual award for 3D cartography, sponsored by GD3D.
awards.elig: Anyone making 3D cartography, real or imagined, in any technique or medium.
awards.need: The BCS awards form plus images or a video of the 3D work.
awards.note: A good fit for 3D renders and physical relief models.

awards.name: BCS Digital Mapping Award
awards.label: Expected June 2027
awards.prize: Award for mapping made for digital use.
awards.elig: Digital maps, GIS projects, interactive web maps, enhanced digital mapping.
awards.need: The BCS awards form and a link to the digital product.
awards.note: Covers interactive web maps and story maps.

awards.name: BCS Ian Mumford Award
awards.label: Expected June 2027
awards.prize: Award for original cartographic research by a student.
awards.elig: University and college students, full or part time.
awards.need: The Ian Mumford form, the research work and a tutor recommendation.
awards.note: For research, such as a thesis or a dissertation chapter, rather than a single map.

awards.name: BCS Children's Map Competition
awards.org: British Cartographic Society with Dennis Maps
awards.label: Expected June 2027
awards.prize: A prize and certificate for the overall winner in each age group.
awards.elig: Children, in age groups; a yearly theme.
awards.need: A map drawn on the year's theme and the entry form.
awards.note: Separate from the ICA Petchenik competition, which BCS also runs for the UK.

awards.name: BCS Henry Johns Award
awards.org: British Cartographic Society with Lovell Johns
awards.label: No entry; chosen from the journal
awards.prize: £100 and a certificate for the best paper in The Cartographic Journal.
awards.elig: Authors of papers in the previous volume of The Cartographic Journal.
awards.need: Publish a paper in The Cartographic Journal.
awards.note: Presented at the BCS annual conference.

awards.name: OpenStreetMap Awards
awards.label: Expected summer 2027
awards.prize: Community-voted awards presented at State of the Map.
awards.elig: Anyone can nominate OSM contributors, teams and projects.
awards.need: A nomination on awards.openstreetmap.org.
awards.note: 2025: nominations until 23 Jul, seven categories. No 2026 edition found.

awards.name: Best Student Geologic Map Competition
awards.label: Via GSA Connects abstract, mid-2027
awards.prize: Awards from the sponsoring societies; poster presented at GSA Connects.
awards.elig: Any student with a geologic map poster.
awards.need: A GSA Connects abstract in the Best Student Geologic Map topical session, then the poster.
awards.note: 2026 edition had 20 posters at GSA Connects in Denver.

awards.name: Ravenstein-Förderpreis
awards.label: Expected late Aug 2027
awards.prize: Prize money, a free one-year DGfK membership and a certificate.
awards.elig: Cartography trainees and university students in German-speaking countries.
awards.need: Online submission through the foundation's portal: the map or project and a short description.
awards.note: 2026 entries closed 28 Aug 2026; the 2026 ceremony is on 12 Nov 2026 in Frankfurt am Main, where the foundation is based.

awards.name: NACIS Student Map & Poster Competition
awards.label: Expected 31 Aug 2027
awards.elig: Students enrolled during the 2026–27 academic year.
awards.need: Map or research poster as PNG, PDF or JPEG.
awards.note: Winners announced at the NACIS annual meeting. Questions: posters@nacis.org.

awards.name: NACIS Student Dynamic Map Competition
awards.label: Expected 31 Aug 2027
awards.prize: $500 for an individual project, $500 for a group project.
awards.elig: Students; interactive or animated maps made in the current academic year.
awards.need: A link to the live interactive or animated map.
awards.note: 28th edition ran at NACIS 2026.

awards.name: GeoHipster Calendar
awards.label: 2027 call closed 23 Oct 2026
awards.prize: About 14 maps printed in the yearly calendar; winners get a free calendar and a write-up.
awards.elig: Any map you made, alone or with colleagues.
awards.need: Hi-res JPG or PNG, landscape, 8 × 10.5 in (20.32 × 26.67 cm) or proportional, with ¼ in bleed and ½ in margins; little small text. Sent by email.
awards.note: The call usually opens in July. Leave room for the author box GeoHipster adds in a corner.

awards.name: Swiss Viz Awards
awards.org: D ONE and Data Innovation Alliance
awards.label: Expected late Oct 2027
awards.prize: Official Swiss Viz Award per category and promotion on Data Innovation Alliance channels.
awards.elig: Anyone, for work made in or about Switzerland.
awards.need: Title, image or video, link, category, purpose, audience, impact, publication date and authors.
awards.note: Categories: Public Lens, Operational Insight, Avant-Garde, Student Work. 2026 round closed 30 Oct; ceremony 10 Dec 2026.

awards.name: Tableau Iron Viz
awards.label: Qualifier usually in autumn
awards.prize: Champion: $15,000 plus $15,000 to a nonprofit. Runners-up: $6,000 plus $6,000. Top 10 qualifiers: $200 Tableau Store card.
awards.elig: Tableau Public users; separate Student Iron Viz.
awards.need: A visualization published on Tableau Public on the qualifier's theme.
awards.note: Qualifier is open for about a month (2025 edition closed 31 Oct 2024).

awards.name: Information is Beautiful Awards
awards.label: Next cycle not announced
awards.prize: Gold, silver and bronze per category, plus shortlist and longlist.
awards.elig: Any data visualization, maps included.
awards.need: Link or images of the work and a short description.
awards.note: Last cycle ran 15 Dec 2024 – 3 Feb 2025.

awards.name: Malofiej Awards
awards.label: Status unclear
awards.prize: Medals for news infographics, including maps.
awards.elig: Newsrooms and infographic designers.
awards.need: Published graphics, print or online.
awards.note: Historically judged in Pamplona each March. No current call found.

awards.name: World Data Visualization Prize
awards.label: Status unclear
awards.prize: Grand prize and category prizes, announced at the World Government Summit.
awards.elig: Anyone.
awards.need: A visualization on the round's theme.
awards.note: Started in 2019. Most recent winners found are from 2023.

awards.name: Copernicus Masters
awards.label: Status unclear
awards.prize: Cash, incubation and data access for Earth observation ideas and start-ups.
awards.elig: Individuals, teams, start-ups and researchers.
awards.need: An idea or product pitch on the online platform.
awards.note: Past calls ran early summer. Also see the EUSPA CASSINI Challenges.

awards.name: Esri India StoryMaps Challenge
awards.label: 2026 cycle, see page
awards.elig: Residents of India.
awards.need: A published ArcGIS StoryMaps story.
awards.note: Separate from the global StoryMaps Competition.

awards.name: Maps.com map submissions
awards.label: Rolling, any time
awards.prize: No prize. Selected maps get an editorial profile with a link back to your work.
awards.elig: Anyone with a published static map, interactive map or video.
awards.need: Title, description, a public URL of the map, data sources, and permission to feature it.
awards.note: Editors look for maps that are bold but still easy to read.
